Definition: properly, to narrow; figuratively, to initiate or discipline
BiblicalUsage: Chanak is training up and dedicating, and it covers houses, children, and temples. A man who has built a new house and not dedicated it may go home from battle, a child is trained in the way he should go, and Solomon dedicated the house of the LORD with twenty-two thousand oxen and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe dedication is the first use of anything: a house, a child, a temple is given to God before it is used for anything else. Proverbs puts the same truth in a parent's hands, and I hold that what is trained toward God early is the thing that does not depart from Him late.
